scope: Newly reproduced temporary-file ownership failure. Earlier targeted/API/CLI checks and frozen performance observations remain recorded accurately; they did not cover this collision.

finding.mechanism: Temporary is armed before OpenOptions(create_new).open succeeds. AlreadyExists leaves the preexisting path unowned, but guard Drop removes it.
finding.observable_effect: A legitimate requested executable whose output path matches the deterministic cache temporary path can be deleted after it has been published, while the CLI still reports Success and fresh Verify=1. The .ll sidecar remains.
finding.overlap_gap: The existing final .psyn destination overlap check does not cover the temporary filename.
finding.minimal_fix: Create/arm the cleanup guard only after create_new succeeds; keep it armed on every later error/cancel and disarm only after successful rename.
required_controls: Preexisting temporary-path sentinel survives AlreadyExists unchanged.
A real requested executable at the temporary path survives cache write failure and remains runnable.
Owned staged file is removed on failed flush/write, rename failure and cancellation; previous final entry remains intact.

reproduction.mechanism: Temporary guard is armed before create_new succeeds. Existing published output causes AlreadyExists and Drop removes the unowned existing file.

followup: CP26 is the separately authorized publication-I/O successor and must include this ownership correction before receiving a new independent Pass. Do not amend or relabel CP22 timing observations.
